name: Jacob Kyle
bio: Doctoral candidate at the University of Oxford researching Utpaladeva and Abhinavagupta. Teaches Sādhana School and the philosophy of recognition, rasa, and Tantric meditation, in the lineage of Paul Muller-Ortega.

name: Nataraj Chaitanya
bio: Has led retreats, kīrtans and teacher trainings for more than twenty years. A formal initiate and custodian of the meditation tradition of Bhagavan Nityananda of Ganeshpuri; based in Melbourne.

name: Tova Olsson
bio: Scholar-practitioner and co-teacher of Song of the Goddess, our Navarātri immersion in the Devī Gītā.

name: Mary Reilly Nichols
bio: Yoga teacher and contemplative guide with decades of experience in the Bhagavad Gītā, Tantra and cross-traditional mysticism.

name: Athena Potari
bio: Philosopher and teacher of the Hellenic wisdom traditions, leading a Wisdom School learning pathway on Greek esoteric thought.
